comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
If you have Pet Training skill and a Pet with Land Area (Search) skill, this item can be acquired from East Ceylon by using Collection/Procurement. It's not the only item to be found there though, so don't expect to stack 200 of them in five minutes or so. Cheers. I wonder which sea zone, if any, a pet with Area Search (Sea) skill might also find them...

Source: blog.goo.ne.jp/cafe-hiyoko/e/cbaf3b2edc8cdd99ad57f04fd0d9615f (JP pet land collection loot guide)
